role: Transparent native Blender homepage instrument master
meaning: An open diagram-layout fixture connects three steel rectangular nodes through one copper decision diamond. Solid graphite orthogonal rails enter fitted node ports; sliding registration collars, real frame recesses, blank metal faces, small corner socket screws, and restrained changes of plane make the diagram a physically coherent three-dimensional object. Detailed machined construction, actual recessed marks, separate fasteners, brushed polished steel, warm oxide copper, graphite interiors, directional softbox reflections, and genuine transparent negative space.
